# Issue #6860 — read-only mutation guard: stop false-failing successful tasks on harness runtime state

Read GitHub issue #6860 in full — THREE successful tasks were mislabeled `failed` today
(evidence on the issue): flagged paths were `.agent/sessions/*.json`, fleet-comms sqlite
`-shm/-wal` side-files, `.pytest_cache/*`, `.pytest_breadcrumbs/*` — all gitignored
harness/tooling runtime state, not repository mutations. Guard lives in
`scripts/delegate.py` ("read-only checkout mutation detected").

ROUTING_CARD_V1: tier=practical · grok-4.6 × native grok CLI (grok-build seat) ·
owned_paths: scripts/delegate.py, tests/** · alternatives: kimi (on #6805, adjacent
surfaces — coordinate: do NOT touch scripts/ai_agent_bridge/**), agy (on #6869-fix2).

## Fix at the right layer (issue names it)
Evaluate mutations against TRACKED content (`git status --porcelain -uno`-equivalent) or
an explicit runtime-state allowlist — the issue lists the four path classes observed;
sweep for siblings (any gitignored-by-default runtime dirs a worker's own tooling
writes). A read-only worker editing a TRACKED file must still hard-fail — do not weaken
that; mutation-check it (#M-16: fake a tracked-file edit in a read-only dispatch test →
must fail).

## Steps
Worktree → implement → regression tests: (a) runtime-state writes → task stays
successful, (b) tracked-file write → still fails, both mutation-checked → pytest + ruff
→ conventional commit referencing #6860 → push → PR. NO auto-merge. Evidence quoted
(#M-4).

## Summary

Read-only dispatches that completed successfully were being marked `failed` because the checkout mutation guard treated gitignored harness/tooling residue as a repository edit.

Observed false-fails on #6860:
- `.agent/sessions/*.json`
- `batch_state/fleet-comms/v1/comms.sqlite3-shm` / `-wal`
- `.pytest_cache/*`
- `.pytest_breadcrumbs/*`

The guard still snapshots ignored files (#4840) so task-authored leaks stay visible. Exemption is an explicit runtime-state allowlist (the four observed classes plus sibling harness/cache dirs and sqlite sidecars) **and** requires ignored/untracked porcelain status. A tracked-file edit still hard-fails.

- Extend `scripts/delegate.py` read-only mutation classification with `_is_read_only_runtime_state_path`
- Keep Entire telemetry (#6803) and the ignored-leak snapshot (#4840)
- Add mutation-checked regressions: runtime-state-only stays `done`; tracked edit still `failed`
